text: the delivery agent assigned for the return pickup visited my address. he claimed he had forgotten his mobile phone and requested that i hand over the return items, promising to scan them later from his home to determine refund eligibility. trusting the process, i handed over the package. shortly afterward, i was shocked to find that my refund had been marked as cancelled. your customer care helpline has been completely unhelpful, keeping me on hold for over 10 minutes multiple times, wasting more than half an hour of my time with no resolution. this is a direct case of delivery agent misconduct and courier fraud. i expect the platform to take responsibility for its representatives.
author: Anju0402
title: Very poor customer service
original_text: The delivery agent assigned for the return pickup visited my address. He claimed he had forgotten his mobile phone and requested that I hand over the return items, promising to scan them later from his home to determine refund eligibility. Trusting the process, I handed over the package. Shortly afterward, I was shocked to find that my refund had been marked as cancelled. ​Your customer care helpline has been completely unhelpful, keeping me on hold for over 10 minutes multiple times, wasting more than half an hour of my time with no resolution. ​This is a direct case of delivery agent misconduct and courier fraud. I expect the platform to take responsibility for its representatives.

text: nykaa fashion very poor unreliable service my experience with the nykaa fashion app has been extremely disappointing. i received wrong products and missing items compared to what was shown and ordered through the application. the worst part is the customer support. i tried contacting them through chat, calls, and email, but i am not getting proper responses or a satisfactory resolution. this makes the entire shopping experience feel untrustworthy and fraudulent. customers pay for the products they order and should receive exactly what was promised. nykaa fashion needs to take responsibility, improve customer support, and resolve such issues quickly instead of ignoring customers. i would strongly advise others to be careful while ordering until these issues are addressed.

title: Nykaa Fashion Is Unreliable – Wrong & Missing Products, No Customer Support
original_text: Nykaa Fashion – Very Poor & Unreliable Service My experience with the Nykaa Fashion app has been extremely disappointing. I received wrong products and missing items compared to what was shown and ordered through the application. The worst part is the customer support. I tried contacting them through chat, calls, and email, but I am not getting proper responses or a satisfactory resolution. This makes the entire shopping experience feel untrustworthy and fraudulent. Customers pay for the products they order and should receive exactly what was promised. Nykaa Fashion needs to take responsibility, improve customer support, and resolve such issues quickly instead of ignoring customers. I would strongly advise others to be careful while ordering until these issues are addressed.

text: nykaa fashion is extremely disappointing. 1,717 was my actual payment, but after nykaa cancelled my order from their own side, they initiated a refund of only 1,688. why should i lose 29 when the cancellation was not made by me? the delivery person didnt even call me to deliver the parcel, and instead of taking responsibility, nykaa cancelled the order and then deducted money from my refund. this is completely unfair and unacceptable. a company of this size should have basic accountability and transparency. if you cancel a customers order, refund the customers full amountdont make the customer pay for your failure. very poor customer service. very disappointing experience. nykaa fashion needs to seriously improve its handling of cancellations and refunds. i expect my full 1,717 to be refunded.
author: Akshay_Bhargav
title: Very Disappointing Experience.
original_text: Nykaa Fashion is extremely disappointing. ₹1,717 was my actual payment, but after Nykaa cancelled my order from their own side, they initiated a refund of only ₹1,688. Why should I lose ₹29 when the cancellation was NOT made by me? The delivery person didn’t even call me to deliver the parcel, and instead of taking responsibility, Nykaa cancelled the order and then deducted money from my refund. This is completely unfair and unacceptable. A company of this size should have basic accountability and transparency. If you cancel a customer’s order, refund the customer’s FULL amount—don’t make the customer pay for your failure. Very poor customer service. Very disappointing experience. Nykaa Fashion needs to seriously improve its handling of cancellations and refunds. I expect my full ₹1,717 to be refunded.
